# DOCSIS 2.0 reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs.py -- do not edit by hand. Run `./docsis docs` to regenerate. -->

Every table below is read out of the code, so it says what this
implementation actually does rather than what it was meant to do.
Section numbers refer to CM-SP-RFIv2.0.

## Timebase

| Quantity | Value | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| master clock | 10.24 MHz | 32-bit counter, wraps every 419.43 s |
| timebase tick | 6.25 µs | 64 master clock counts |
| mini-slot | M ticks | M a power of two; the unit MAPs allocate in |
| timing adjust unit | 97.65625 ns | 1/64 tick = one master clock count; the RNG-RSP resolution |

## MAC frame control

```
+----+----------+-----------+----------+-----+---------+
| FC | MAC_PARM |  LEN/SID  |   EHDR   | HCS | payload |
+----+----------+-----------+----------+-----+---------+
  1       1           2       0..240      2

FC:  bits 7..6  FC_TYPE
     bits 5..1  FC_PARM
     bit  0     EHDR_ON
```

LEN counts the extended header **as well as** the payload (Table 6-3),
and a Packet PDU carries the whole Ethernet frame including its FCS.

### FC_TYPE

The two high bits of FC: which kind of frame this is.

| Value | Name | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `PACKET` |  |
| 1 | `ATM` |  |
| 2 | `ISOLATION` |  |
| 3 | `MAC_SPECIFIC` |  |

| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `TIMING` | carries SYNC |
| 1 | `MAC_MGMT` |  |
| 2 | `REQUEST` | a bare 6-byte frame: MAC_PARM is a mini-slot count, LEN/SID a SID |
| 3 | `FRAGMENTATION` |  |
| 4 | `QUEUE_DEPTH_REQ` |  |
| 28 | `CONCATENATION` | several MAC frames in one burst |

### Header Check Sequence

CRC-16 variant `x25` (poly 0x1021, init 0xFFFF, reflected in and out, final complement -- the HDLC FCS-16), transmitted least-significant byte first. See `docs/WIRESHARK.md` for how that was established.

## MAP information element

```
 31                18 17    14 13                 0
+--------------------+--------+-------------------+
|      SID (14)      | IUC (4)|    offset (14)    |
+--------------------+--------+-------------------+
```

A grant runs from its own offset to the offset of the *next* element, which is why a MAP always ends with a Null IE.

## The two configuration-file MICs

The **CM MIC** (TLV 6) is an MD5 over every configuration setting in file order except the two MIC settings. It detects a corrupted download and nothing more -- anyone can recompute it.

The **CMTS MIC** (TLV 7) is an MD5 over the settings below, *in this order*, with the shared secret appended. The order is normative: two implementations that disagree about it fail to authenticate each other even with the same secret.

| # | Type | Name |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 1 | `DOWNSTREAM_FREQUENCY` |
| 2 | 2 | `UPSTREAM_CHANNEL_ID` |
| 3 | 3 | `NETWORK_ACCESS_CONTROL` |
| 4 | 4 | `CLASS_OF_SERVICE` |
| 5 | 17 | `BASELINE_PRIVACY_CFG` |
| 6 | 43 | `VENDOR_SPECIFIC` |
| 7 | 6 | `CM_MIC` |
| 8 | 18 | `MAX_CPE` |
| 9 | 19 | `TFTP_SERVER_TIMESTAMP` |
| 10 | 20 | `TFTP_SERVER_ADDRESS` |
| 11 | 22 | `UPSTREAM_CLASSIFIER` |
| 12 | 23 | `DOWNSTREAM_CLASSIFIER` |
| 13 | 24 | `UPSTREAM_SERVICE_FLOW` |
| 14 | 25 | `DOWNSTREAM_SERVICE_FLOW` |
| 15 | 28 | `MAX_CLASSIFIERS` |
| 16 | 29 | `PRIVACY_ENABLE` |
| 17 | 26 | `PAYLOAD_HEADER_SUPPRESSION` |
| 18 | 35 | `SUBSCRIBER_MGMT_CONTROL` |
| 19 | 36 | `SUBSCRIBER_MGMT_CPE_TABLE` |
| 20 | 37 | `SUBSCRIBER_MGMT_FILTER_GROUPS` |

## Timers

| Timer | Value | Waiting for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| lost sync | 600 ms | a SYNC message |
| T1 | 10 s | a usable UCD |
| T2 | 10 s | a broadcast Initial Maintenance opportunity |
| T3 | 200 ms | a RNG-RSP |
| T4 | 30 s | a unicast Station Maintenance opportunity |
| T5 | 2 s | a UCC-RSP |
| T6 | 3 s | a REG-RSP |
| T7 | 1 s | a DSA/DSC response |
| T8 | 300 ms | a DSA/DSC acknowledgement |

| Limit | Value |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SYNC interval (max) | 200 ms |  |
| UCD interval (max) | 2 s |  |
| ranging retries | 16 | consecutive T3 timeouts before the modem abandons the channel |
| contention ranging retries | 16 |  |

## Channel arithmetic

### Downstream (ITU-T J.83 Annex B)

| Modulation | MPEG-TS Mbit/s | DOCSIS payload Mbit/s | 1518-byte frame (µs) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 64-QAM | 26.97035 | 26.397 | 460.1 |
| 256-QAM | 38.81070 | 37.985 | 319.7 |

The payload rate is the transport-stream rate times 184/188, since each 188-byte TS packet carries a 4-byte header.

### Upstream channel widths

| Width (MHz) | ksym/s | Describable by a type-2 UCD | 64-QAM raw Mbit/s |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.2 | 160 | yes | 1.20 |
| 0.4 | 320 | yes | 2.40 |
| 0.8 | 640 | yes | 4.80 |
| 1.6 | 1280 | yes | 9.60 |
| 3.2 | 2560 | yes | 15.36 |
| 6.4 | 5120 | **no** | 30.72 |

DOCSIS 1.x stops at 2560 ksym/s, so a 6.4 MHz channel cannot be expressed in a type-2 UCD at all and is invisible to a 1.x modem.

### Mini-slot capacity, default lab upstream

US1 30.000 MHz 3.2 MHz 2560 ksym/s A-TDMA (DOCSIS 2.0) 64-QAM minislot=4 ticks (25.00 us) 15.36 Mbit/s raw

| IUC | Usage | Modulation | FEC | Bytes/mini-slot | Mini-slots for 64 B | for 1518 B |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Request | QPSK | T=0 k=16 | 16 | 5 | 96 |
| 3 | Initial Maintenance | QPSK | T=5 k=34 | 16 | 7 | 125 |
| 4 | Station Maintenance | QPSK | T=5 k=34 | 16 | 7 | 125 |
| 5 | Short Data Grant | 16-QAM | T=5 k=75 | 32 | 4 | 56 |
| 6 | Long Data Grant | 16-QAM | T=8 k=220 | 32 | 4 | 53 |
| 9 | Adv PHY Short Data Grant | 64-QAM | T=5 k=75 | 48 | 3 | 38 |
| 10 | Adv PHY Long Data Grant | 64-QAM | T=10 k=232 | 48 | 3 | 36 |

A mini-slot is a slice of *time*, so its byte capacity depends entirely on the burst profile the grant was issued under. The mini-slot counts include Reed-Solomon parity, preamble and guard time, which is why they exceed a naive division.

## Plant

Velocity of propagation 0.87c, coaxial loss 1.4 dB/km bounded at 18 dB to stand in for the amplifier cascade a real plant is built with.

| Distance (km) | One way (µs) | Round trip (µs) | Ranging offset (units) | Residual loss (dB) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 3.83 | 7.67 | 79 | 1.4 |
| 5 | 19.17 | 38.34 | 393 | 7.0 |
| 10 | 38.34 | 76.68 | 785 | 14.0 |
| 25 | 95.85 | 191.70 | 1963 | 18.0 |
| 50 | 191.70 | 383.41 | 3926 | 18.0 |
| 80 | 306.73 | 613.45 | 6282 | 18.0 |
| 160 | 613.45 | 1226.90 | 12563 | 18.0 |

The ranging offset a modem converges on *is* its distance from the CMTS, which is the single most useful thing to watch in a run.

## States

### CMTS-side, as reported by `show cable modem`

| State | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `offline` | not heard from |
| `init(r1)` | initial ranging: first RNG-REQ received on the broadcast Initial Maintenance region, temporary SID assigned |
| `init(r2)` | ranging: applying timing/power/frequency corrections via unicast Station Maintenance |
| `init(rc)` | ranging complete: upstream timing is locked |
| `init(d)` | DHCP DISCOVER seen, waiting for the exchange to finish |
| `init(i)` | IP address assigned by DHCP |
| `init(t)` | Time of Day exchange |
| `init(o)` | downloading the configuration file over TFTP |
| `reject(m)` | registration rejected: MIC check failed |
| `reject(c)` | registration rejected: class of service not admitted |
| `online(d)` | registered, but network access is disabled in the config file |
| `online` | registered and forwarding |

### Modem-side, as reported by `show cm`

| State | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `offline` | powered off |
| `ds-scan` | scanning the downstream spectrum for a DOCSIS carrier |
| `ds-lock` | QAM and FEC lock acquired on a downstream |
| `sync-wait` | waiting for a SYNC message to establish the timebase |
| `ucd-wait` | waiting for a UCD describing a usable upstream (T1) |
| `ranging-wait` | waiting for a broadcast Initial Maintenance opportunity, deferring per the ranging back-off (T2) |
| `ranging-initial` | initial RNG-REQ sent with SID 0, waiting for RNG-RSP (T3) |
| `ranging-station` | applying timing/power corrections via unicast Station Maintenance |
| `ranging-complete` | upstream timing locked |
| `dhcp` | acquiring an IP address by DHCP over the DOCSIS data path |
| `time-of-day` | acquiring time of day (RFC 868) |
| `tftp-config` | downloading the configuration file over TFTP |
| `registering` | REG-REQ sent, waiting for REG-RSP (T6) |
| `operational` | online and forwarding |
| `rejected` | registration rejected by the CMTS |
